title: 第6章 躲着听瓜
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 徐喜弟果然在溪边找到了巴儿姐。她正挽着袖子，在帮人洗衣服，用板锤砰砰砰打衣。一个老婶子瞪大着眼睛，盯着她晃动的那两团肥肉，一边啧啧啧个不停。巴儿姐像是知道老婶子在感慨什么，红着脸咕哝：巴巴，阿巴……捶打衣服更用力了。她就是这样，爱热闹，大家笑她就跟着笑，完完全全乐在其中。不远处，李二拐撅着屁股坐在树底下，嘴里叼着一根狗尾巴草。看到徐喜弟冷着脸从村里走出来，两人四目对峙了不到半分钟，他就吓得立马捂着屁股，一跛一跛走得远远的。这个狗东西，看来早就盯着巴儿姐了。昨天尝到了甜头，以后只怕越发明目张胆。徐喜弟走向溪边，李婶最先看到她，脸色一僵，也不敢笑了，划了一点水泼到另外一个老婶子的脸上。“你干嘛泼我！”吴婶还以为是李婶在嬉闹，也划了一些水反击过去。“咳咳，喜弟，你今天不洗衣服吗？”李婶见她没看懂，挤着笑跟徐喜弟打招呼。吴婶一听，头也没回，就从巴儿姐手上抢走衣服，还嫌弃地说道，“唉唉，都说了不用你洗，你洗不干净，我还得洗一遍。”说着，还真把衣服铺水里，然后捞起来，搓了一点泡泡果，拿起锤子砰砰砰锤打起来。巴儿姐回头看了一眼徐喜弟，脸色也变得讪讪，像做错事的孩子，低着头站起来，把袖子往下捋好，然后默默转身回家。徐喜弟也没跟这些老婶子多聊，她知道她们背后经常议论她，当面一套背后一套。果然她转身才走了几步，就听见她们有人拿她来当话题。‘你们发现没有，这小媳妇走路不一样了。’‘哪里不一样？’‘嘿，你是真不懂还是装不懂，小姑娘走路，大腿捏得紧，你看看她……’‘还真是，两条大腿蹩开了呢……’徐喜弟远远一听，还真低头看了一眼，这些八婆还能看出来这个？她心虚地夹了夹腿。可是话题一旦被这些人扯开，就有说不完的后续，大伙七嘴八舌地参与来。‘话说她也十八岁了吧？’‘你们说，永福他能行吗？’‘谁知道，说不定只是腿脚软，那里硬呢？’‘那谁在上面，谁在下面？’‘我见过永福的腿，还没我手臂粗，软哒哒的，能使得上劲？’哈哈哈……溪边笑成一片。已经走远的徐喜弟，却羞愤得无地自容。她捏着拳就准备回头跟她们理论干仗，抬头就看到刘宇宁和他妈王秀菊，两人各自抱着一捆薄膜迎面走过来。“宇宁哥，去洗东西吗？”徐喜弟松了拳头，愉快地跟他们打招呼。刘宇宁应了一声，脸有点红。他停下脚步，打算再多聊几句。王秀菊却黑着一张脸，莫名其妙白了徐喜弟一眼，然后腾出一只手去扯自己儿子。“赶紧的，洗完回家，你爸还等着用呢！”刘宇宁只能跟着快步往溪边走。老婶子们看到刘宇宁，话题立马就转到了他的身上。“呀，宇宁回来了？”“听说你回来，今天才见到，变化可真大啊？”刘宇宁笑着跟她们打招呼，两排白牙有点晃眼。到了溪边下游的位置，把薄膜摊开就往水里铺。李婶瞧着他眼睛直放光，“宇宁，你有对象了没？婶这边有个好姑娘，介绍给你怎么样？”刘宇宁没有回答，但是王秀菊接了话，“好呀，是谁家姑娘？读过书吗？”她们嗓门很大，徐喜弟也没走多远，还能清楚听见。不知道怎么的，听到她们要给刘宇宁介绍对象，她也有点好奇。像他这样，读了书又当了兵，回来还有工作，算是村里最有出息的，不知道得多优秀的姑娘才能配得上？他可是见过世面的人，跟村里的村夫糙汉不一样。听王秀菊的意思，要找读过书的媳妇，大家脸色就有点五彩缤纷了。读书？这十里八乡的，能读书的姑娘，可不多。家家户户三五个孩子，这两年也才能勉强吃上饭，有的还没吃饱，还想读书？“书也读了一年，但她很勤快，家里家外一把好手。人也长得好看，这要是放到咱们村，除了徐喜弟，谁家姑娘都比不上。”李婶似乎对她推荐的人很有自信。可王秀菊却不买账，“才读一年吗，那小学都没毕业啊！能写字吗？我家宇宁以后可是去镇上工作的，媳妇说不定要一起去……”意思很明显，没文化，配不上，也带不出手。“这样啊……”李婶听出来了，收了嘴。刘宇宁往四周望了一圈，然后笑着接话，“没读书也不要紧的，我姐也没读完小学，我们家不嫌弃。”“现在日子虽然好起来了，但跟我一辈的女孩子，大部分都没什么机会上学的。”徐喜弟一愣，连脚步都放慢了许多，想听听他们后面还说什么，快步闪到一棵小树后面，竖着耳朵听。她向来被村里的姑娘和老婶子们排除在外，想听瓜通常都这么悄咪咪偷听一耳朵。刘宇宁嘴角带着笑，继续说道，“我有工作，能养家。我媳妇也不用那么勤快，只需要在家带孩子就行。”呀！好男人啊！徐喜弟暗暗给他竖起一个大拇指，当过兵的人，心就是正。不愧是村里最有出息的男人，谁能嫁他全家都得半夜笑醒，祖坟绝对嘎嘎冒紫烟！“呀，宇宁可真是个好样的！”吴婶忍不住一个夸赞。刘宇宁满脸带笑，但说的话却像是认真的。王秀菊在一旁，怔怔地看了一眼自己的儿子。“可不嘛！十里八乡都找不出来第二个。”李婶也跟着夸。“有你这话，婶就放心了，要不这两天我带你上他们村瞧瞧去？保证你能中意。”刘宇宁又抬头望了一圈，然后低头快速地搓手里的薄膜。“这恐怕不行，我过两天就要去单位报到了。”王秀菊听到这，才暗暗松了一口气。原来刚刚儿子说的都是客气话，不是认真的。“那你下次什么时候回来？我让人家姑娘过来咱们村一趟，也是可以的。”李婶显然不死心。
content_en: Sure enough, Xu Xidi found Sister Ba'er by the stream.She was rolling up her sleeves, helping people wash clothes, banging clothes with a hammer.An old aunt stared at the two lumps of fat she was shaking with her eyes wide open, and kept tutting her tongue.Sister Ba'er seemed to know what the old aunt was lamenting. She blushed and muttered: Baba, Abba... She beat her clothes harder.That's how she is, she loves to be lively, she laughs when everyone laughs, and she enjoys it completely.Not far away, Li Erguai sat under the tree with his butt stuck out, a piece of dogtail grass in his mouth.Seeing Xu Xidi walking out of the village with a cold face, and the two of them stared at each other for less than half a minute, he was so frightened that he immediately covered his buttocks and limped away.This bitch seems to have been staring at Sister Ba'er for a long time.I tasted the sweetness yesterday, but I'm afraid it will become more and more blatant in the future.Xu Xidi walked towards the stream. Aunt Li saw her first. Her face froze and she didn't dare to laugh. She splashed some water on the other old aunt's face."Why are you splashing on me!" Aunt Wu thought it was Aunt Li who was playing around, so she also paddled some water to fight back."Ahem, Xidi, aren't you going to do the laundry today?" Seeing that she didn't understand, Aunt Li greeted Xu Xidi with a smile.When Aunt Wu heard this, she snatched the clothes from Sister Ba'er's hand without looking back, and said disgustingly, "Oh, I told you that you don't need to wash it. If you can't wash it clean, I have to wash it again." After saying that, she actually put the clothes in the water, then picked them up, rubbed some bubble fruit, picked up the hammer and started hammering.Sister Ba'er turned back and glanced at Xu Xidi, her face became sullen, like a child who had done something wrong. She stood up with her head lowered, smoothed down her sleeves, and then silently turned around and went home.Xu Xidi didn't talk much to these old aunts. She knew that they often talked about her behind her back, doing one thing to her face and another behind her back.Sure enough, after she turned around and walked a few steps, she heard some of them using her as a topic.‘Have you noticed that this little wife walks differently?’ ‘What’s the difference?’ ‘Hey, do you really don’t understand or are you pretending not to understand? When the little girl walks, her thighs are tightly squeezed. Look at her...’ ‘Really, her thighs are spread apart...’ When Xu Xidi heard this from a distance, he really lowered his head and took a look. How could these bastards see this?She crossed her legs guiltily.But once the topic is brought up by these people, there will be endless follow-up, and everyone will participate in it.‘By the way, she is also eighteen years old, right?’ ‘You say, can he achieve eternal happiness?’ ‘Who knows, maybe it’s just that the legs and feet are soft, but where is the hardness?’ ‘Then who’s on top and who’s on the bottom?’ ‘I’ve seen Yongfu’s legs. They’re not as thick as my arms. They’re so soft. Can they make you stronger?’ Hahahaha... everyone was laughing by the stream.Xu Xidi, who had gone far away, was so ashamed and angry that he felt ashamed.She clenched her fists and was about to turn around to argue with them. When she looked up, she saw Liu Yuning and his mother Wang Xiuju, each holding a bundle of films walking towards them."Brother Yuning, are you going to wash things?" Xu Xidi relaxed his fists and greeted them happily.Liu Yuning responded, his face a little red.He stopped and planned to chat a few more words.Wang Xiuju had a dark face, rolled her eyes at Xu Xidi inexplicably, and then freed up a hand to pull her son."Hurry up, come home after washing, your dad is still waiting to use it!" Liu Yuning could only follow and walked quickly to the stream.When the old ladies saw Liu Yuning, the conversation immediately turned to him."Ah, Yu Ning is back?" "I heard that you are back, and I just saw you today. What a big change?" Liu Yuning greeted them with a smile, and his two rows of white teeth were a bit dazzling.When you reach the lower reaches of the stream, spread out the film and spread it into the water.Aunt Li looked at him with bright eyes, "Yuning, have you found someone? There is a good girl here, how about introducing her to you?" Liu Yuning did not answer, but Wang Xiuju answered, "Okay, whose girl is it? Have you read a book?" Their voices were loud, and Xu Xidi didn't go far enough to hear her clearly.For some reason, she was a little curious when she heard that they were going to introduce someone to Liu Yuning.Like him, he studied and became a soldier, and still has a job when he comes back. He is considered the most promising in the village. I wonder how good a girl is to be worthy of this?He is a man who has seen the world, unlike the rough guys in the village.After hearing Wang Xiuju's suggestion that she wanted a wife who had read books, everyone's faces became a bit colorful.read?There are not many girls in this country who can study.There are three or five children in each family, and they can barely afford to eat in the past two years. Some of them are not full yet, and they still want to study?"She has been studying for a year, but she is very hard-working and a good hand at home and abroad. She is also good-looking. If this were placed in our village, no girl except Xu Xidi can compare with her." Aunt Li seemed to be very confident in the person she recommended.But Wang Xiuju didn't buy it, "You only studied for one year, and you haven't even graduated from elementary school! Can you write? My Yuning will go to work in the town in the future, and my wife may want to go with her..." The meaning is obvious, she is uneducated, not worthy, and can't help."That's it..." Aunt Li heard it and stopped talking.Liu Yuning looked around, and then answered with a smile, "It doesn't matter if you haven't studied. My sister has not finished elementary school. Our family doesn't mind." "Although life is getting better now, most girls of my generation have no chance to go to school." Xu Xidi was stunned, and even slowed down a lot. Wanting to hear what they were going to say next, he quickly moved behind a small tree and listened with his ears straightened.She has always been excluded by the girls and old aunts in the village, and Xiang Tinggua usually eavesdrops so quietly.Liu Yuning continued with a smile on his face, "I have a job and can support my family. My wife doesn't have to be so diligent, she only needs to take care of the children at home." Yeah!What a man!Xu Xidi secretly gave him a thumbs up. People who have served as soldiers have a good heart.He is indeed the most promising man in the village. Whoever marries him will make the whole family wake up laughing in the middle of the night. The ancestral graves will definitely rattle with purple smoke!"Ah, Yu Ning is really good!" Aunt Wu couldn't help but praise her.Liu Yuning was smiling, but what he said seemed serious.Wang Xiuju stood aside and glanced at her son blankly."No! I can't find another one from all over the country." Aunt Li also praised her."With your words, Auntie will feel relieved. How about I take you to their village in the next two days to have a look? I guarantee you will like it." Liu Yuning looked up again, then lowered his head and quickly rubbed the film in his hands."I'm afraid this won't work. I'm going to report to my unit in two days." Wang Xiuju breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this.It turns out that what my son said just now were all polite words and he was not serious."Then when will you come back next time? It's okay if I ask the girl to come to our village." Aunt Li obviously didn't give up.
